   - *Form & Ergonomics:* Pistol grip for stability and trigger actuation. Grip diameter ~32mm (fits average adult hand, works with thin nitrile gloves). Trigger reach ~18mm from grip front. Center of mass ~60mm from grip base, balanced for one-handed use. Gloved use: oversized trigger pocket, tactile feedback, high-contrast screen.
   - *Material + Process:* Injection moulding (PP/ABS blend) for production; FDM/SLA for prototyping. Wall thickness: 2.0mm uniform. Draft angles: 1-2° on vertical walls. Surface finish: MT#3 (matte, slight texture) for grip, glossy for screen bezel.
   - *DFM Decisions:* 1) Snap-fit shell halves with interference clips (no side-actions needed). 2) Integrated screw bosses with threaded inserts for Pi/cell retention. 3) Vents sealed with IP54-rated acoustic/thermal membrane to protect electronics while allowing heat dissipation.
   - *Thermal & Ingress:* Passive convection via top/bottom slots covered by hydrophobic membrane. Sealed seams with O-ring groove or interference fit. IP54 rating.
   - *Accessibility:* High-contrast UI, tactile trigger with audible click, voice feedback option, large screen bezel for easy handling with limited dexterity.
